Pulse 0.14.0

What's new:
- Fuyao (扶摇), Hithink / Tonghuashun's official A-share data service. Bring your own API key (Settings → Data Sources → 同花顺) to upgrade Shanghai and Shenzhen quotes to real-time — the API returns sub-second-fresh snapshots, verified live during a trading session. Pulse routes A-share quotes and daily candles through Fuyao when a key is present, and falls back to the existing free sources automatically when the key is missing or the circuit breaker trips.
- Unified provider status model in Settings. Longbridge and Fuyao now share the same connection-status vocabulary and the same retry flow, so every data source in the list answers the same questions the same way: connected, connecting, disconnected, or error — with a one-tap retry that clears the circuit breaker without touching credentials.

No setup or account changes are required after updating. If you use Tonghuashun and want real-time A-share quotes, add your Fuyao API key in Settings → Data Sources.

For first-time installation, download Pulse-0.14.0.dmg and drag Pulse to Applications. The zip asset is used by Sparkle automatic updates.
